Name: (Tsundere) Wizard Marriage Mod (Unofficial Update For SVE version)
Author: erinyang
Description:
[color=#e69138][size=4][b]【Introduction】[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]This mod is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7139]Yuzu's Tsundere Wizard Mod[/url](original),  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21580]Qyuef's 1.6 update[/url] for it. Thanks for their work!
I worked on making it compatible with SVE.
If you are not using SVE, please remove this mod and use[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21580] Qyuef's update[/url] instead.

This mod is [color=#ff0000]not compatible[/color] with other Wizard marriage mod like RRRR or Looking for Love. Check on it before you run the game.  

Now it comes with English (edit from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12884]Isari112[/url]'s translation) and Chinese translations. And also supports i18n files. If you are interested in making translations for other languages, let me know so I can put up a link to your mod page!
[/size]If you find any problem with translations, coding, leave a comment and I will fix it as soon as possible!


[color=#e69138][size=4][b]【Requires】[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Go to direct page for installation guide
1[b]. [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]  (Required for SVE)
4. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]  (Required for this mod)
5. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Menu[/url]  (Optional)[/size][/color]


[color=#e69138][size=4][b]【Installation】[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1. Download this mod
2. Unzip it to your Mod folder.
3. If you have Mod config Menu, just use the in game menu for setting.
    If you don't, just use any notepad APP open config.json to edit:
[/size][code]{
﻿"Nickname": "Name", (What wizard calls you after married. You can change to "Baby" or "Darling")
  "WizardTiedHair": "True", (Changes the character that if ties hair or not on Flower Dance.)
  "WizardStyle": "Default" (Character style opition. "Default" as dark hair, "White" as white hair)
}
[/code]

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]【Notice】[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1[/size][size=3]. Mature Events in SVE have a lot conflict to this mod's events. So [/size][color=#ff0000]DO NOT[/color][size=3] activate those events!![/size]
[size=3]2. In case of copy rights, I use the other character style of this mod in the Shrine of Illusion event in SVE (which temporarily changes wizard's look).[/size]
[size=3]3. SVE contains a lot of content. Please write down post if there is anything that I didn't cover well.[/size]
[size=3]4.[/size][b] [/b][size=3]Portraits and sprites includes frames specifically for this mod, so it is not compatible with others. Don't use it with other wizard character mod![/size]

[/size][size=3]Hearts Events Condition:
1.Two Hearts (06:00-09:00, Forest, Rainy)
2.1 Four Hearts - 1 (14:00-17:00, Tower, Sat. *There will be a special dialogue if the two hearts event has been triggered.)
2.2 Four Hearts - 2 (20:00-22:00, Tower, Having the item he requested in the above event. *The day will end in this event.)
2.3 Five Hearts (14:00-16:00, Tower, Tue or Wed, Having seen the Four Heart Events 1&2.)
3.1 Six Hearts - 1 (17:00-18:00, Breach, Sunny)
3.2 Six Hearts - 2 (09:00-16:00, Forest, Sunny, Mon-Fri, Having two hearts with Jas and Vincent)
3.3 Seven Hearts (10:00-16:00, Forest, Sunny, Sun, Having seen the Six Heart Events 1&2.)
4. Eight Hearts (20:00-23:00, Forest, Sunny, Sun, Having seen all the events of stages 2 and 3, Having greeted all the townies) You will receive the letter from the Wizard.
5. Ten Hearts: (Tower, Having seen all the above events)

Post-Marriage Events Condition:
1. Eleven Hearts (14:00-17:00, Tower, Thu, not the Winter, Known Krobus).
2. Twelve Hearts (09:00-17:00, Town, Sat, Sunny) You will receive the letter from the Mayor.
3. Forteen Hearts (09:00-17:00, Town, Sunny) *There is a follow-up event (with CG) when you come home at night, the day will end in this event.[/size]

[size=4]【简介】[/size]
[size=3]这个 Mod 是我根据由柚太太制作的[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7139]法师可婚 mod[/url] （SVE版）和 Qyuef 制作的 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21580]1.6 适配版[/url]的基础上进行加工完善的。[/size]
[size=3]如果你想使用这个 Mod ，请先安装前置 mod，并保证文件夹内没有其他法师可婚的 mod 存在（比如 RRRR），这些 mod 基本是不能互相兼容的。[/size]
[size=3]如果你没有安装SVE，请移除此 Mod，安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21580]Qyuef[/url] 制作的通用版。[/size]

目前已新增i18n文件供翻译。如果你有兴趣制作其他语言的翻译，请联系我为你在此页面添加翻译链接！


[color=#e69138][size=4][b]【前置】[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]前置的安装方法请到对应 Mod 简介页面了解。（不过基本都是解压后放进 Mods 文件夹里）[/size]
[size=3]1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=3]3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url] （SVE的前置）[/size]
[size=3]4. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] （必须有SVE才能此mod）[/size]
[size=3]5. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Menu[/url] （可选）[/size]


[color=#e69138][size=4][b]【安装】[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1. 下载此 mod[/size]
[size=3]2. 解压后将文件夹放进 Mods 文件夹内。[/size]
[size=3]3. 已安装 Mod config Menu 的玩家可以直接进入游戏，按照自己的喜好进行设置。[/size]
[size=3]    没有的玩家可以用任何记事本软件打开 config.json，按照喜好进行修改：[/size]
[code]{
  "Nickname": "Name", （婚后法师对玩家的称呼，@为玩家的名字，还可以改成"Baby"宝宝或"Darling"亲爱的）
  "WizardTiedHair": "true", （花舞节上法师是否束发选项，"True"为是，"False"为否）
  "WizardStyle": "Default" （法师的形象，"Default"为默认深蓝发，"White"为白发精灵耳）
}
[/code]

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]【剧情触发】[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]事件触发条件：
1. 二心（06-09点、森林、下雨）；
2.1 四心-1（14-17点、法师塔、星期六）*触发过二心事件会有特别对话。
2.2 四心-2（20点22点、携带四心-1事件所要求的物件进入法师塔）*此事件发生后会进入第二天；
2.3 五心（14-16点、法师塔、星期二或三、发生过四心系列两个事件）；
3.1 六心-1（17-18点、沙滩、晴天）3.2 六心-1（9-16點、森林、晴天、星期一至五、和贾斯及文森特分別有兩心好感）；
3.3 七心 (10-16点、森林、晴天、星期日、发生过六心系列两个事件）；
4. 八心（发生过第2阶段及第3阶段所有事件，认识所有星露谷原版镇民，之后会收到法师的信**、20-23点、森林、晴天） *触发过二心事件会有特別对话；
5. 十心（发生过上述所有事件进入法师塔）。

婚后事件触发条件:
1. 十一心（14-17点、法师塔、星期四、不是冬天、认识科罗布斯）
2. 十二心（收到镇长的信后、09-17点、鹈鹕镇、星期六、晴天）
3.十四心 （CG事件）（09-17点、鹈鹕镇、晴天）*发生过十四心事件前的当晚回家，會有后续事件(含CG)，此事件发生后会进入第二天。[/size]


[color=#e69138][size=4][b]【注意事项】[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1. SVE 中的 Mature Events（成人向剧情）内容上会与本 mod 存在极大的冲突，请务必[color=#ff0000]不要[/color]开启这个内容选项！！
2. SVE 的幻觉神龛剧情中，为避免授权纠纷等问题，我将法师变身后的形象设置为他在本 mod 中的另一款形象。比如深蓝发法师会变为白发（只是一小段剧情内容，马上就会变回去）。
3. 由于 SVE 的文本量较大，也许会存在部分内容是我没有改到的，还请见谅。
4. 此 mod 与其他法师相关的美化、剧情、对话 mod 可能会存在冲突，尽量不要与其他法师mod混用。
5. 在使用过程中遇到任何问题、bug，可以在这里评论区或是我的[url=https://space.bilibili.com/289662648/dynamic]B站动态[/url]进行反馈！
6. 8心事件触发需要认识所有星露谷本体的其他npc才能触发（目前我是把这个条件去掉了，下次更新会补回来）

[/size]
